facts.fact: ST DIGITAL, a pan-African operator of sovereign data centres, states it operates data centres in Cameroon (among seven countries) hosting clients such as banks, telecom operators, administrations and enterprises; the post is not specific to a named Cameroonian site and gives no opening date, so the post date is used.

ST DIGITAL states its data centres, including those deployed in Cameroon, are Tier 3 / TIA-942 constructed; the operator's own statement, no Uptime Institute certificate cited and no Cameroonian site named; the post date is used as no other date is given.

note: Facts are for ST DIGITAL's Cameroon infrastructure as stated generically across seven countries.
